jurisdictions.name: Alameda County (unincorporated)
jurisdictions.notes: Building permits for unincorporated areas are issued by the Public Works Agency Building Inspection Department, 399 Elmhurst Street, Hayward. Phone is the 'Need Help?' contact on the inspection requests page. The Permits page lists only the agency main line, (510) 670-5480. The automated inspection request line is (510) 670-6451. ADU zoning rules are on the Community Development Agency Planning page (Permit Center / Zoning Counter (510) 670-5400). parcel_lookup_url is the Community Locator, linked from https://www.acgov.org/uninc/ as https://communitylocator.acgov.org/ (which redirects here). It is an interactive map showing whether a location is in one of the county's unincorporated communities. The Planning Department also links a Zoning Viewer Public Access Map at https://accda.maps.arcgis.com/apps/webappviewer/index.html?id=303ba7fe78934234ac3c42af53754c43.

jurisdictions.name: Alameda
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is the Permit Center contact number. The Building Division page lists only the inspection line, (510) 747-6830. Portal is Accela Citizen Access.

jurisdictions.name: Albany
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is the Community Development Department contact number shown on the Building page. No separate Building Division number is published. Portal is Cloudpermit.

jurisdictions.name: Berkeley
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is the Building & Safety Division contact on the Planning and Development department page. Building & Safety has no standalone page. The Permit Service Center is (510) 981-7500. Portal is Accela ('Permits Online'). ADU page title is 'Residential Additions and Accessory Dwelling Units'. berkeleyca.gov answers HEAD requests with 403 but GET with 200.

jurisdictions.name: Dublin
jurisdictions.notes: Published as 925-833-6620 for Building & Safety. Portal is Tyler EnerGov Citizen Self Service, linked from https://www.dublin.ca.gov/2735/Online-Permits.

jurisdictions.name: Emeryville
jurisdictions.notes: No online permit portal. The city takes applications as emailed PDFs to the permit technician or in person at City Hall, 1333 Park Avenue. Inspection request line is (510) 596-4315.

jurisdictions.name: Fremont
jurisdictions.notes: fremont.gov returned 403 (Akamai bot block) to every request, including robots.txt, so no value was read from the city site. The Accela portal (agency COF) identifies itself as 'the City of Fremont's Development Permitting Portal' but was not confirmed via a link on fremont.gov. Building page, phone, and ADU page need a manual check in a browser.

jurisdictions.name: Hayward
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is the Building Division main line, 777 B Street. Portal is Tyler EnerGov, reached from https://www.hayward-ca.gov/epermits. Pre-approved ADU plans are at https://hayward-ca.gov/pre-approval-of-ADU-plans.

jurisdictions.name: Livermore
jurisdictions.notes: livermoreca.gov returned 403 (Akamai bot block) to every request, including robots.txt, so nothing was verified. An Accela portal exists at https://aca-prod.accela.com/LIVERMORE/Default.aspx but shows no city branding and was not confirmed via the city site, so it is left out. All fields need a manual check in a browser.

jurisdictions.name: Newark
jurisdictions.notes: newarkca.gov returned 403 (Akamai bot block). Phone was read on the city's vendor-hosted eTRAKiT permit portal: 'For general Building Inspection Division questions or information, please call 510-578-4261'. The portal links to the Building Inspection Division page at https://www.newarkca.gov/departments/public-works/building-inspection-division/, which could not be loaded, so building_dept_url is null. ADU entry is the 'Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)' section of the city housing subsite.

jurisdictions.name: Oakland
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is labeled 'Building Counter'. The Planning & Building Department main line is (510) 238-3443 and building inspections is (510) 238-3444. Building is part of the combined Planning & Building Department. Portal is Accela ('Online Permit Center').

jurisdictions.name: Piedmont
jurisdictions.notes: Phone is under 'Customer service > Call us' on the About Building page (Planning & Building Department). City Hall main line is (510) 420-3040. Portal is eTRAKiT; the city no longer accepts paper or email applications. The portal firewall sometimes rejects scripted requests with 503.

jurisdictions.name: Pleasanton
jurisdictions.notes: No standalone Building Division page; building permit content is on the Community and Economic Development 'Permits, Forms & Fees' page. Phone is the Building & Safety number printed in the city's OTC Plan Review handout PDF. The city web pages list the Permit Center as (925) 931-5630. Portal is Accela, linked as https://aca.cityofpleasantonca.gov/CitizenAccess/Default.aspx.

jurisdictions.name: San Leandro
jurisdictions.notes: Published as 'Building & Safety Services Phone: 510-577-3405'. Portal is Accela. Pre-Reviewed ADU Program page is https://www.sanleandro.org/1386/Pre-Reviewed-ADU-Program.

jurisdictions.name: Union City
jurisdictions.notes: Published as 'Building Phone: 510.675.5313'. Inspection request line is 510.487.0711. No general online permit portal; submittals go to the Building Division counter or by email. SolarAPP+ handles residential solar only (https://www.unioncityca.gov/836/Solar-App). The only ADU web page found is the Pre-Approved ADU Program page.
